full_source_reviews.title: Real2Sim2Real for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation: An AMD ROCm-Based Pipeline
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 manuscript fully read. The paper documents four AMD/ROCm demonstrations and public resource URLs, but provides no formal experimental protocol, uncertainty, failure distribution, safety contract, or dedicated limitations section; its strongest claims remain vendor-authored, task-specific demonstration evidence.

limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.22997v1#S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1 — the real-robot transfer evidence is qualitative and scoped to the described basic pick-and-place distribution
https://arxiv.org/html/2607.22997v1#S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1 — cross-device throughput is task/algorithm dependent and the text itself attributes results to unisolated host, synchronization and batch effects
locators.artifact: https://github.com/AMD-AIM/Physical_AI_Challenge; https://github.com/PhysicalAI-AIM/Robot_synthetic_data_generation_workshop; https://github.com/ZJLi2013/vk-gsplat-plugin — exact v1 discloses these resources, but event-time immutable commits and an end-to-end reproduction were not audited, so no code-level or reproducibility claim is retained

full_source_reviews.problem: A Physical-AI workflow can fragment across simulation, reconstruction, VLA training and robot deployment when each phase depends on a different accelerator software stack.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: The paper composes Genesis simulation, LeRobot-format demonstrations, SmolVLA fine-tuning, 3DGS scene reconstruction, ROCm/PyTorch execution and physical Franka deployment into four demonstrations on AMD hardware. It is a portability and workflow-integration case, not a new VLA, sim-to-real, control, or scheduling mechanism.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: Simulation owns synthetic environment state; 3DGS owns a reconstructed static scene; Genesis owns interactive physics and trajectory generation; LeRobot owns dataset serialization; the VLA owns action proposals; the physical controller and robot execute them. The paper does not specify a versioned handoff contract, safety authority, calibration lifecycle, or causal correspondence between simulated and physical state.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: The paper reports one basic synthetic grasping distribution at 100%, 4,000 SmolVLA steps in roughly 7–11 minutes under 2.4 GB VRAM, qualitative zero-additional-finetuning transfer to a Franka arm, and four locomotion throughput cells across several devices. It reports neither trial counts for the real transfer nor confidence intervals, failure taxonomy, held-out scene success, matched host controls, tail latency, control frequency, safety outcomes or independent replication.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: A unified software stack lowers phase-boundary integration cost, but it can hide task-specific kernel maturity, driver/version coupling and host bottlenecks behind an end-to-end label. Photorealistic 3DGS backgrounds do not guarantee contact dynamics; synthetic success can fail under calibration, sensor, friction and latency shift. Vendor-authored cross-hardware throughput without matched controls cannot establish a general hardware ranking.

Ch26 already separates simulation breadth, real calibration, online correction, physical controller authority and safety envelope; Ch27 already treats synthetic/Real2Sim data as a versioned data-generation contract. The paper supplies a vendor-specific realization but does not add a durable owner proposition.

It does not prove general sim-to-real robustness, safety, causal world-model correctness, matched cross-hardware superiority, or artifact-complete reproduction.

full_source_reviews.title: Libra: Taming Attention Workload Skew in Long-Context LLM Training with Bounded Sequence Pool
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact v1 with workload model, mathematical scaling argument, complete design and data/control flow, implementation, production-scale end-to-end measurements, component breakdowns and explicit counterevidence reviewed. No public Libra implementation URL is disclosed in v1.

limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.23250v1#S2.SS2 — the design is scoped to dense causal attention; sparse or linear attention is left to future work
https://arxiv.org/html/2607.23250v1#S5.p6 — raw-sample step semantics are preserved but bitwise-equivalent gradients, optimizer states and trajectories are explicitly not claimed

https://arxiv.org/html/2607.23250v1#S6.SS1 — WLB-LLM is reimplemented without outlier deferral and DistCA is scope-emulated rather than run end-to-end; PP bubble reduction is inferred from forward-time compression rather than a pipeline trace
locators.artifact: Not Disclosed — exact v1 contains no public Libra code or artifact URL; the MagiAttention repository is a cited baseline resource, not the reviewed system's implementation

full_source_reviews.problem: Fixed-token packing balances memory and linear-cost operators, but dense attention cost for a packed sequence follows the sum of squared constituent lengths. Long-tailed samples therefore create cross-CP-group stragglers that throttle DP synchronization and inflate PP bubbles even when every packed sequence has the same token count.
full_source_reviews.mechanism: Libra freezes the raw-sample multiset of each optimizer step, partitions its DP replicas into fixed-size sequence pools, uses exact-cardinality variance-reduced placement to pair complementary packed-sequence workloads across pools, then dispatches sequence-by-head tiles within each pool. A CPU planner emits per-iteration plans; the GPU executor performs planned Q/K/V and output all-to-all around an unmodified variable-length FlashAttention kernel, with chunked overlap. Scaling DP creates more pools rather than expanding the communication domain of each pool.
full_source_reviews.state_ownership_and_flow: The global sampler owns optimizer-step membership and VRSP order; each PP-stage pool owns a bounded redistribution domain; a designated CPU coordinator owns the reusable per-pool/per-iteration tile plan; the executor owns transient Q/K/V/output movement but no scheduling decision; the ordinary optimizer and checkpoint remain authoritative. Pool groups are reconstructed after restart and plans are regenerated, so no Libra runtime state enters checkpoints.
full_source_reviews.evaluation_and_counterevidence: On Qwen3-30B-A3B production training with 256K and 1M packed sequences, DP-only scale-outs range from 8–128 and 16–256 NVIDIA GPUs respectively. At DP=16, author measurements raise relative scaling from 7.63x to 13.66x for 256K and 4.42x to 11.25x for 1M. Microbenchmarks report up to 3.14x worst-step attention speedup and component sweeps show communication rises with pool size. However, the strongest external baselines are not run as their complete systems, no PP pipeline trace is collected, and P=4 slightly beats the simulator-selected P=8 in the reported sweep.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: A bounded pool reduces global communication exposure and indivisible-outlier pressure, but adds all-to-all traffic, CPU planning, metadata broadcast, tile/KV bookkeeping and floating-point reordering. Pool size and tile shape are workload/topology dependent; overlap cannot hide first-dispatch/final-return costs, and adding more pools still grows the worst-pool tail. The evidence assumes microbatch size one, dense causal attention, proprietary production datasets and one NVIDIA NVLink/RoCE environment. Ordinary packing/Ulysses remains preferable when sequence skew is mild or orchestration cost dominates; a broader global pool may win inside a uniformly high-bandwidth domain.

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch36 add a bounded attention-workload-pool branch after the existing Context Parallel buffer discussion. Preserve fixed-token packing and Ulysses as the simple baseline; explain why equal tokens do not equal equal dense-attention work, why optimizer-step sample identity must remain fixed, how inter-pool placement and intra-pool tile dispatch split control, and why pool scope trades straggler reduction against communication and planner state. Handoff packing identity to Ch27 and PP bubble semantics to Ch38.
full_source_reviews.source_claim: The exact v1 supports that equal-token packing can leave dense-attention workload skew, and that a bounded sequence-pool design with step-preserving placement, sequence-head tiling and overlapped tensor exchange improved the stated Qwen3/NVIDIA workloads. It does not establish bitwise training equivalence, sparse/linear-attention applicability, complete end-to-end superiority over WLB-LLM or DistCA, public reproducibility, or topology-independent gains.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Fixed-token packing plus Ulysses is reasonable when token count approximates work and variation remains within each CP group. Long-tailed raw sequences break that approximation because attention work is quadratic within each constituent sequence, while cluster-wide disaggregation expands the communication and failure domain. The changed constraint is therefore not merely more GPUs, but the scope over which work may be redistributed without changing optimizer-step membership.

deep_analysis_units.narrative: 固定 token packing 在 activation memory 和线性算子主导时是合理基线，却把一个关键差异藏起来：dense attention 的工作量取决于 packed sample 内各原始序列长度平方和，长尾 outlier 会跨 CP group 形成同步 straggler。只在本地重排无法拆开 indivisible outlier，把 attention 提升为 cluster-wide service 又让通信域随集群增长。Libra 的演进是先冻结 optimizer-step 的 raw-sample multiset，再用 fixed-size DP pools 限定 redistribution domain，以 VRSP 控制 pool 间有限样本偏斜、以 sequence×head tiles 控制 pool 内 GPU 偏斜，最后用 pipeline overlap 隐藏部分交换。收益是缩小 DP wait 与 PP forward-time dispersion；代价是 planner/metadata/all-to-all、floating-point reorder 和 topology-sensitive 参数，且 first/last transfer 不能被 overlap 消除。短 context、轻 skew 或 orchestration cost 更重要时，packing + Ulysses 仍成立；高带宽统一域内 global pool 仍是另一分支。

books_serialization_queue.heading: ### 从等 Token Packing 到有界 Attention Workload Pool
books_serialization_queue.patch_text:
固定 token packing 让每个 packed sequence 占用相同 token budget，能够平衡 activation memory 和线性复杂度算子；Ulysses 再在每个 CP group 内切分 sequence/head view。在 raw sample 长度分布不重、或 communication orchestration 更昂贵时，这条路径仍最简单。但 dense causal attention 的工作量近似取决于 packed sample 内各原始序列长度平方和：相同 token 数可以对应完全不同的 attention FLOPs，跨 CP groups 的最慢 replica 会继续拖住 DP synchronization，并把不均匀 microbatch 时间传给 PP bubble。

一种实验性演进不是把 outlier 延迟到下一 optimizer step，也不是把 attention 扩成 cluster-wide service，而是先冻结本 step 的 raw-sample multiset，再把若干 DP replicas 组成固定大小的 sequence pool：全局 sampler 用 workload-aware、exact-cardinality placement 让各 pools 的总 attention work 接近；每个 pool 内再把 sequence×head tiles 分配到 GPU，并由 per-iteration CPU plan 驱动 Q/K/V 与 output exchange。DP 扩容时增加 pool 数量而不扩大单个 pool，使 redistribution scope、通信域和 failure domain 保持有界。Sampler 拥有 step membership，pool planner 只拥有执行放置，optimizer/checkpoint 仍拥有训练状态；restart 后重建 groups 并重算 plan，而不是把临时调度状态写入 checkpoint。

这条路线获得更小的 straggler tail，却新增 all-to-all bytes、CPU planning、metadata broadcast、KV dedup、floating-point operation reorder 与 topology-sensitive pool/tile 参数。更大的 pool 提高聚合范围，也会增加通信；overlap 只能隐藏中段，first dispatch 和 final return 仍暴露。现有证据绑定 Qwen3-30B-A3B、256K/1M packed sequences、mbs=1 与 NVIDIA NVLink/RoCE，且没有证明 bitwise-equivalent gradient、sparse/linear attention、完整 DistCA/WLB-LLM end-to-end superiority 或跨 topology 收益。短 context、轻 skew 或控制开销占主导时，packing + Ulysses 仍更合理；统一高带宽域内，global pool 也仍是可比较分支。数据 packing identity 归 Ch27，PP bubble 与 schedule 归 Ch38，本章只拥有跨并行维度的 workload redistribution contract。

- Libra（exact v1；Status: Experimental）：https://arxiv.org/html/2607.23250v1
